messages:
tia-docs: Heads-up — found an edge case where tool responses include embedded newlines inside JSON strings and our parse examples choke on it. Need a short docs note + SDK helper example. Sample log from prod:

```
tool_response = '{\"message\": \"Line1\nLine2\"}'
# parser currently throws JSONDecodeError on streaming chunks
```

sam-ml: Yep, saw this in the telemetry. Our heuristics assumed no raw newlines inside string values when concatenating chunks. We should recommend either canonical escaping (\n) or using a helper to join then json.loads. Quick fix: docs should show both the malformed case and the safe case.

alex-sdk: I can add a small helper in the SDK: sanitize_tool_output(raw: str) -> dict that normalizes escaped newlines and validates against a given schema. Draft snippet (Python + TS) I'll attach to the PR. Example Python snippet I plan to include:

```python
def sanitize_tool_output(raw: str) -> dict:
    # replace bare newlines in JSON string values with escaped 
    fixed = raw.replace('\\n', '\\\\n')
    return json.loads(fixed)
```

and TypeScript shim:

```ts
export function sanitizeToolOutput(raw: string): any {
  const fixed = raw.replace(/\\n/g, "\\\\n");
  return JSON.parse(fixed);
}
```

maya-eng: Also add a short JSON Schema example showing both accepted shapes: 1) { message: string } where string may include newlines (escaped), and 2) { message: { lines: string[] } } as an alternative for callers that prefer arrays. That helps teams choose a canonical contract.

chris-qa: I'll add tests for these vectors. Can you add a cURL example that streams a chunk with a bare newline so we can assert the SDK fix prevents failures? Example test payload I want in the docs: `{\"message\":\"first line\nsecond line\"}`.

alex-sdk: Will include migration note in SDK changelog: bump to v1.12.0 with "sanitize_tool_output" helper and a short usage example. Also will add a small integration test that runs the docs cURL vector.

deploy-bot: docs-preview: built tia/escape-fix -> https://docs-preview.internal/branches/tia/escape-fix/index.html (expires in 72h) :rocket:

tia-docs: Nice. Two follow-ups: 1) add a short migration checklist for teams relying on parse fallbacks (call out the new helper and example commands), and 2) include a note under "structured output" about when to prefer function-calling vs tool-calling for multi-line payloads.

sam-ml: Agreed re: checklist. Also add a short telemetry note: we will log a parse-fallback event for one release so customers can see if they're affected.

tia-docs: Great — I'll open the docs PR and tag @alex-sdk + @chris-qa for review. Will also paste the preview link in the PR body. Thanks everyone :pray:
